title: 老美的政府封禁大疆，老美的警察却在用它 大疆这回真是扬眉吐气了。 8月14日，美国上诉法院裁定：五角大楼把大疆列入“中国军事企业”黑名单，证据不足，发回重审。这是中国硬科技在制裁铁幕上亲手凿开的第一道裂缝。 但比法庭更精彩的，是美国的基层。 圣芭芭拉消防局用大疆热成像无人机，从太平洋里捞起一个快沉下去的冲浪者；休斯顿警局组建新战术单元，核心装备是大疆Matrice 4T，性能更强，价格只有美产的一半；加州尔湾警局连续两年的开放日，展示的无人机全是大疆。 全美超过80%的执法和应急机构在用大疆技术，商用市场占七到九成，农用无人机每五架就有四架是大疆，不是不想买美国货，是买不起——同等功能贵三到五倍，性能还跟不上。 虽然法庭上的程序还没走完，但地面上的胜负早就分出来了：当大疆的产品好到基层都离不开时，顶层的封禁，终

title_en: The government of the United States has banned DJI, but the police of the United States are using it. DJI is really proud this time. On August 14, the U.S. Court of Appeals ruled that the Pentagon’s blacklisting of DJI as a “Chinese military enterprise” lacked sufficient evidence and remanded the case for retrial. This is the first crack China’s hard technology has dug in the iron curtain of sanctions. But what’s even more exciting than the courts is America’s grassroots. The Santa Barbara Fire Department used a DJI thermal imaging drone to pick up a sinking surfer from the Pacific Ocean; the Houston Police Department established a new tactical unit, and the core equipment is the DJI Matrice 4T, which has stronger performance and is only half the price of American products; the Irvine Police Department in California has held its open days for two consecutive years, and all the drones on display are DJI. More than 80% of law enforcement and emergency agencies in the United States use DJI technology, accounting for 70 to 90% of the commercial market. Four out of every five agricultural drones are DJI. It's not that they don't want to buy American products, but they can't afford them - the same functions are three to five times more expensive, and the performance can't keep up. Although the court process has not yet been completed, the winner on the ground has long been decided: when DJI's products are so good that grassroots people can't live without them, the top-level ban will eventually
